method: Observed through Codex in-app browser UI; demos exported through the page download button

checks.description: Fresh localhost page automatically connects to configured Groq service without entering secrets in the UI
Conversation demo: 3/3 actual model replies, including cooking invitation; no knowledge writes
Learning demo: 5/5 actual model replies; unknown, teach, controlled omission, correction, sampled recall
Learning memory preserves the complete steps during omission and records red string after correction, 2 lessons, 1 correction, mastery 0.55
Returning from demos restores the original blank conversation; demo memories do not appear there
Direct ordinary chat respects a request for quiet company and generates a Chinese reply without a question
Original ordinary chat and per-reply provenance survive browser reload and backend restart
Both recorded demos load through their frontend buttons and direct query links, explicitly labelled as recordings
No browser JavaScript errors observed in final demo pages

limitations: Finite synthetic examples, not a general language quality evaluation
One learning step explicitly requests controlled omission
Public GitHub Pages site was not deployed
Mobile viewport and legacy optional Python browser suite were not executed in this verification
